player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Mupira wa miguu akajaribu kukubali biashara bila kuwa na rasilimali muhimu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muthu {player_id}, Kitendo kisichowezekana. Safu {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Muthu {player_id} anakusanya kufanya ofa ya biashara bila kuwa na zilombo zinazohitajika.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Muthu {player_id} anakusanya ofa ya biashara katika muundo usio sahihi.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Muthu {player_id} hakufanya ofa mpya ya biashara.

offers.accept: Muthu {acceptor_id} alikubali ofa ya biashara kutoka kwa Muthu {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Muthu {player_id} alifanya ofa ifuatayo kwa Muthu {opponent_id}: Zilombo zinazotolewa: {offered} -> Zilombo zinazoulizwa: {requested}

outcome.win: Muthu {winner_id} alishinda kwa kuwa na ongezeko kubwa la thamani ya zilombo.
outcome.draw: Mabadiliko sawa ya thamani ya zilombo kwa wachezaji wote. Sawa.
